Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class DexpiConnectionInfo

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.DexpiConnectionInfo
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class DexpiConnectionInfo extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable source-evidence record for one Proteus-compatible DEXPI material connection.

This record preserves source order, direction, ownership, and endpoint-resolution evidence. It does not reconstruct or imply live ProcessSystem topology.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

      public DexpiConnectionInfo(String id, String sourceId, String segmentId, String fromId, String toId, String fromElementName, String toElementName, boolean fromResolved, boolean toResolved)
      Creates an immutable connection evidence record.
      Parameters:
      id - stable evidence identity
      sourceId - source connection identity, or empty when absent
      segmentId - owning piping-network segment identity, or empty when absent
      fromId - source endpoint identity
      toId - target endpoint identity
      fromElementName - resolved source XML element name
      toElementName - resolved target XML element name
      fromResolved - whether the source endpoint resolves in the source document
      toResolved - whether the target endpoint resolves in the source document
